::: {.callout-important title="Historical demonstration"}
This source describes the January 2026 demonstration using data through 2024.
See the October 2026 [document evaluation](reports/evaluation.qmd) and
[updated-input audit](reports/updated-inputs.qmd) before rerunning or interpreting
the MSE. The scientific corrections proposed in that review remain pending.
:::

## Overview

This document converts `openMSE/R/sca_openmse.R` into a narrative Quarto report.
It walks through how the `pm_24` data are parsed and mapped to the SCA model
inputs, documents key parameter choices, and produces figures and tables that
summarize the fit and downstream MSE outputs.

From a scientific perspective, the workflow links observed removals and survey
indices to an age-structured assessment, derives life-history relationships,
and propagates those outputs into an operating model and management strategy
evaluation. Key run settings are summarized in @tbl-config, the temporal
and age coverage in @tbl-data-summary, and the primary input signals are
visualized in @fig-catch-series and @fig-survey-indices. Growth and
maturity derivations are documented in @tbl-growth-params and
@fig-length-at-age, @fig-weight-length, and @fig-maturity-curve, while the
assessment and MSE outputs are synthesized in @tbl-sca-summary,
@fig-sca-timeseries, and @fig-mse-metrics-plot, with MP comparisons in
@fig-mse-pplot, @fig-mse-kplot, and @fig-mse-tplot and the quilt summary
in @tbl-mse-quilt.

## Setup

This section loads the analysis libraries and defines consistent plotting and
table defaults used throughout the report. The standardized table styling
supports the configuration summary in @tbl-config and the data coverage
overview in @tbl-data-summary, while the plotting theme is applied to
@fig-catch-series and @fig-survey-indices for direct comparability.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(MSEtool)
library(SAMtool)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

options(width = 120)
set.seed(123)

theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

gt_caption <- function(df, caption = NULL) {
  # Captions are handled by chunk options to enable cross-references.
  gt::gt(df)
}
```

## Configuration and file paths

This section defines the mortality, stock-recruitment form, projection horizon,
and growth parameters that govern the assessment and MSE. These values, along
with input/output paths, are summarized in @tbl-config and provide the
biological context for the growth curves shown in @fig-length-at-age.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-config
#| tbl-cap: "Run configuration and file locations."

# Resolve paths relative to the working directory.
doc_dir <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
if (basename(doc_dir) != "openMSE" && dir.exists(file.path(doc_dir, "openMSE"))) {
  doc_dir <- file.path(doc_dir, "openMSE")
}

dat_rds <- file.path(doc_dir, "data", "pm_24.rds")
dat_file <- file.path(doc_dir, "data", "pm_24.dat")
report_dir <- file.path(doc_dir, "reports")

# Core configuration
M_value <- 0.3
SR <- "BH"
proyears <- 50
nsim_om <- 48
fix_h <- TRUE
steep <- 0.9

# Von Bertalanffy parameters (from pm.tpl lines 6464-6467)
vbLinf <- 68.43045172
vbK <- 0.139339914
L0 <- 25.23382299

config_tbl <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "dat_rds", "dat_file", "report_dir",
    "M_value", "SR", "proyears", "nsim_om", "fix_h", "steep",
    "vbLinf", "vbK", "L0"
  ),
  Value = c(
    normalizePath(dat_rds, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    normalizePath(dat_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    normalizePath(report_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    M_value, SR, proyears, nsim_om, fix_h, steep, vbLinf, vbK, L0
  )
)

gt_caption(config_tbl)
```

## Load and parse input data

The assessment uses the cached `pm_24.rds` if available. If not, it will parse
`pm_24.dat` and write the cached RDS for subsequent runs.
The parsed data drive the coverage summary in @tbl-data-summary and the
input time series visualizations in @fig-catch-series and
@fig-survey-indices, which establish the empirical constraints for the SCA.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Data parser for ADMB-format tab-delimited .dat files
read_data <- function(file) {
  lines <- readLines(file)
  result <- list()
  current_name <- NULL
  buffer <- list()

  for (line in lines) {
    line <- trimws(line)
    if (line == "") next
    if (startsWith(line, "#")) {
      if (!is.null(current_name)) {
        result[[current_name]] <- if (length(buffer) == 1) buffer[[1]] else do.call(rbind, buffer)
      }
      current_name <- sub("^#", "", line)
      buffer <- list()
    } else {
      nums <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(line, "\\s+")))
      buffer[[length(buffer) + 1]] <- nums
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(current_name)) {
    result[[current_name]] <- if (length(buffer) == 1) buffer[[1]] else do.call(rbind, buffer)
  }

  result
}

if (file.exists(dat_rds)) {
  dat <- readRDS(dat_rds)
  data_source <- "pm_24.rds"
} else {
  if (!file.exists(dat_file)) {
    stop("Missing data file: ", dat_file,
         "\nRun once with pm_24.dat present to create the cached RDS: ", dat_rds)
  }
  dat <- read_data(dat_file)
  saveRDS(dat, dat_rds)
  data_source <- "pm_24.dat (cached to RDS)"
}
```

Data source used: `r data_source`.

```{r}
#| label: extract-fields

# Extract scalars
styr <- as.integer(dat$styr)
endyr <- as.integer(dat$endyr)
recage <- as.integer(dat$recage)
nages <- as.integer(dat$nages)
nyears <- endyr - styr + 1
ages <- recage:(recage + nages - 1)

# Extract vectors and matrices
obs_catch <- as.numeric(dat$obs_catch)
p_mature <- as.numeric(dat$p_mature)
wt_fsh <- dat$wt_fsh

# Survey indices
yrs_bts <- as.integer(dat$yrs_bts_data)
ob_bts <- as.numeric(dat$ob_bts)
ob_bts_std <- as.numeric(dat$ob_bts_std)
n_bts <- as.integer(dat$n_bts)

yrs_ats <- as.integer(dat$yrs_ats_data)
ob_ats <- as.numeric(dat$ob_ats)
ob_ats_std <- as.numeric(dat$ob_ats_std)
n_ats <- as.integer(dat$n_ats)

yrs_avo <- as.integer(dat$yrs_avo)
ob_avo <- as.numeric(dat$ob_avo)
ob_avo_std <- as.numeric(dat$ob_avo_std)
n_avo <- as.integer(dat$n_avo)

# Fishery catch-at-age
yrs_fsh <- as.integer(dat$yrs_fsh_data)
n_fsh <- as.integer(dat$n_fsh)
sam_fsh <- as.numeric(dat$sam_fsh)
oac_fsh <- dat$oac_fsh_data

# Normalize catch-at-age rows to proportions
oac_fsh_prop <- oac_fsh / rowSums(oac_fsh)
```

@tbl-data-summary summarizes the temporal span, age structure, and survey
coverage that determine the effective information content of the assessment.
These coverage attributes frame the variability observed in @fig-catch-series

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data-summary

summary_tbl <- data.frame(

    "Start year", "End year", "Number of years",
    "Recruitment age", "Max age", "Number of ages",
    "BTS observations", "ATS observations", "AVO observations",
    "Fishery CAA years", "Catch range"
  ),
  Value = c(
    styr, endyr, nyears,
    recage, max(ages), nages,
    n_bts, n_ats, n_avo,
    n_fsh, paste0(round(catch_range, 2), collapse = " to ")
  )
)

gt_caption(summary_tbl)
```

### Catch and survey indices

Observed removals and survey indices provide the primary abundance signals for
fitting the SCA. @fig-catch-series shows the catch history, while
@fig-survey-indices compares BTS, ATS, and AVO indices (with AVO rescaled for
visualization). The sampling density underlying these series is summarized in
@tbl-data-summary.

```{r}
#| label: fig-catch-series
#| fig-cap: "Observed catch time series (metric tons)."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

catch_df <- data.frame(Year = styr:endyr, Catch = obs_catch)

ggplot(catch_df, aes(Year, Catch)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "steelblue") +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(title = "Catch time series", x = "Year", y = "Catch") +
  theme_report
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-survey-indices
#| fig-cap: "Survey indices used in the assessment (BTS, ATS, AVO)."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

# Rescale AVO to improve comparability in a single panel
avo_scale <- mean(ob_bts, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(ob_avo, na.rm = TRUE)

survey_df <- data.frame(
  Year = c(yrs_bts, yrs_ats, yrs_avo),
  Index = c(ob_bts, ob_ats, ob_avo),
  Survey = c(
    rep("BTS", length(yrs_bts)),
    rep("ATS", length(yrs_ats)),
    rep("AVO", length(yrs_avo))
  )
)

survey_df$SurveyPlot <- ifelse(survey_df$Survey == "AVO", "AVO (rescaled)", survey_df$Survey)
survey_df$IndexPlot <- ifelse(survey_df$Survey == "AVO", survey_df$Index * avo_scale, survey_df$Index)
survey_df$SurveyPlot <- factor(survey_df$SurveyPlot, levels = c("BTS", "ATS", "AVO (rescaled)"))

ggplot(survey_df, aes(Year, IndexPlot, color = SurveyPlot)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(title = "Survey indices", x = "Year", y = "Index (AVO rescaled)") +
  theme_report
```

## Growth, weight-length, and maturity

We derive length-at-age from the Von Bertalanffy parameters and fit a
weight-length relationship from the mean fishery weights-at-age.
These life-history relationships determine the conversion between age,
length, and biomass in both the assessment and the operating model. Derived
parameters are summarized in @tbl-growth-params, with supporting
trajectories shown in @fig-length-at-age, @fig-weight-length, and
@fig-maturity-curve.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-growth-params
#| tbl-cap: "Derived growth and maturity parameters."

# Derive t0 from L0 (length at recage)
vbt0 <- recage + log(1 - L0 / vbLinf) / vbK

# Predicted length-at-age
len_at_age <- vbLinf * (1 - exp(-vbK * (ages - vbt0)))

# Mean weight-at-age from fishery data
mean_wt_age <- colMeans(wt_fsh)

# Fit weight-length: log(W) = log(a) + b * log(L)
wl_fit <- lm(log(mean_wt_age) ~ log(len_at_age))
wla <- exp(coef(wl_fit)[1])
wlb <- coef(wl_fit)[2]

# Derive L50 and L95 from maturity-at-age interpolated to length-at-age
L50 <- approx(p_mature, len_at_age, xout = 0.5)$y
L95 <- approx(p_mature, len_at_age, xout = 0.95)$y

growth_tbl <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("vbt0", "wla", "wlb", "L50", "L95"),
  Value = c(round(vbt0, 3), signif(wla, 4), round(wlb, 4), round(L50, 1), round(L95, 1))
)

gt_caption(growth_tbl)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-length-at-age
#| fig-cap: "Length-at-age derived from Von Bertalanffy parameters."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

len_df <- data.frame(Age = ages, Length = len_at_age)

ggplot(len_df, aes(Age, Length)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "steelblue") +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(title = "Length-at-age", x = "Age", y = "Length (cm)") +
  theme_report
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-weight-length
#| fig-cap: "Weight-length fit from mean weight-at-age."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

wl_df <- data.frame(Length = len_at_age, Weight = mean_wt_age)
pred_len <- seq(min(len_at_age, na.rm = TRUE), max(len_at_age, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
pred_df <- data.frame(Length = pred_len, Weight = wla * pred_len^wlb)

ggplot(wl_df, aes(Length, Weight)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.7, color = "gray30") +
  geom_line(data = pred_df, linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(title = "Weight-length fit", x = "Length (cm)", y = "Weight") +
  theme_report
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-maturity-curve
#| fig-cap: "Maturity at length with L50 and L95 reference points."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

mat_df <- data.frame(Length = len_at_age, Maturity = p_mature)

ggplot(mat_df, aes(Length, Maturity)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(L50, L95), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "Maturity curve", x = "Length (cm)", y = "Maturity") +
  theme_report
```

## How data are fit to the model

The table below maps the core data streams to the model inputs used in SCA and
OM conditioning. This delineates where each piece of information enters the
estimation workflow.
@tbl-data-mapping provides the traceability between observed series
(@fig-catch-series and @fig-survey-indices) and the Data/Assess2OM
inputs, ensuring that each source is explicitly accounted for.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data-mapping
#| tbl-cap: "Mapping of raw data to model inputs."

fit_map <- data.frame(
  Data_element = c(
    "Total catch (obs_catch)",
    "BTS index (ob_bts, ob_bts_std)",
    "ATS index (ob_ats, ob_ats_std)",
    "AVO index (ob_avo, ob_avo_std)",
    "Catch-at-age (oac_fsh_prop)",
    "Weight-at-age (wt_fsh)",
    "Maturity-at-age (p_mature)",
    "Natural mortality (M_vec)",
    "Growth (vbLinf, vbK, vbt0)",
    "Weight-length (wla, wlb)"
  ),
  Used_in = c(
    "Data@Cat",
    "Data@Ind + Data@CV_Ind",
    "Data@AddInd[ ,1, ] + Data@CV_AddInd[ ,1, ]",
    "Data@AddInd[ ,2, ] + Data@CV_AddInd[ ,2, ]",
    "Data@CAA (age-0 padded)",
    "Assess2OM: waa",
    "Assess2OM: Mataa",
    "Assess2OM: Maa",
    "Data@vbLinf, Data@vbK, Data@vbt0",
    "Data@wla, Data@wlb"
  ),
  Notes = c(
    "1 x nyears catch time series",
    "Primary index (BTS) with CVs and NA padding",
    "Additional survey index",
    "Additional survey index",
    "Normalized to proportions; age-0 column added",
    "Used both for weight-length fit and OM conditioning",
    "Replicated across years for OM",
    "Age-specific M used in OM; constant M in Data object",
    "Used for length-at-age and growth representation",
    "Log-linear fit on mean weight-at-age"
  )
)

gt_caption(fit_map)
```

## Build the MSEtool Data object

The Data object consolidates observation, life-history, and configuration inputs
into the structure required by the SCA. Parameters in @tbl-config and the
data provenance in @tbl-data-mapping are embedded here, while the
life-history relationships shown in @fig-length-at-age and
@fig-maturity-curve ensure biological consistency between the assessment and
OM conditioning stages.

```{r}
#| label: build-data

pollock_data <- new("Data")
pollock_data@Name <- "EBS Pollock"
pollock_data@Year <- styr:endyr
pollock_data@MaxAge <- max(ages)
pollock_data@Mort <- M_value
pollock_data@steep <- steep

# Catch time series (1 x nyears matrix)
pollock_data@Cat <- matrix(obs_catch, nrow = 1)

# Primary index: BTS
bts_full <- rep(NA_real_, nyears)
bts_cv_full <- rep(NA_real_, nyears)
bts_full[yrs_bts - styr + 1] <- ob_bts
bts_cv_full[yrs_bts - styr + 1] <- ob_bts_std / ob_bts
pollock_data@Ind <- matrix(bts_full, nrow = 1)
pollock_data@CV_Ind <- matrix(bts_cv_full, nrow = 1)

# Additional indices: BTS, ATS, AVO
AddInd <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(1, 3, nyears))
CV_AddInd <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(1, 3, nyears))

AddInd[1, 1, yrs_bts - styr + 1] <- ob_bts
CV_AddInd[1, 1, yrs_bts - styr + 1] <- ob_bts_std / ob_bts

AddInd[1, 2, yrs_ats - styr + 1] <- ob_ats
CV_AddInd[1, 2, yrs_ats - styr + 1] <- ob_ats_std / ob_ats

AddInd[1, 3, yrs_avo - styr + 1] <- ob_avo
CV_AddInd[1, 3, yrs_avo - styr + 1] <- ob_avo_std / ob_avo

pollock_data@AddInd <- AddInd
pollock_data@CV_AddInd <- CV_AddInd
pollock_data@AddIunits <- c(1L, 1L, 1L)

# Vulnerability schedule (biomass surveys)
pollock_data@AddIndV <- array(1, dim = c(1, 3, max(ages) + 1))

# Catch-at-age: pad age-0 column with zeros
caa_full <- matrix(0, nrow = nyears, ncol = nages + 1)
caa_full[yrs_fsh - styr + 1, 2:(nages + 1)] <- oac_fsh_prop
pollock_data@CAA <- array(caa_full, dim = c(1, nyears, nages + 1))

# Sample sizes for CAA (proxy)
pollock_data@CV_Cat <- matrix(0.05, nrow = 1, ncol = nyears)

# Life history parameters
pollock_data@vbLinf <- vbLinf
pollock_data@vbK <- vbK
pollock_data@vbt0 <- vbt0
pollock_data@wla <- wla
pollock_data@wlb <- wlb
pollock_data@L50 <- L50
pollock_data@L95 <- L95
pollock_data@LenCV <- 0.06
```

## Run the SCA assessment

The SCA fits an age-structured model to the assembled Data object to estimate
reference points and historical stock status. Key outputs are summarized in
@tbl-sca-summary, while @fig-sca-timeseries tracks depletion and
relative fishing mortality through time and @fig-sca-selectivity
characterizes terminal-year selectivity.

```{r}
#| label: run-sca

res <- SCA(
  x = 1,
  Data = pollock_data,
  AddInd = 1:3,
  SR = SR,
  vulnerability = "dome",
  catch_eq = "Baranov",
  fix_h = fix_h,
  max_age = max(ages)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sca-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Key SCA outputs."

sca_tbl <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("R0", "h", "FMSY", "MSY", "SSB0", "Terminal SSB/SSB0", "Terminal F/FMSY"),
  Value = c(
    signif(res@R0, 4),
    round(res@h, 3),
    round(res@FMSY, 4),
    round(res@MSY, 1),
    signif(res@SSB0, 4),
    round(tail(res@SSB_SSB0, 1), 3),
    round(tail(res@F_FMSY, 1), 3)
  )
)

gt_caption(sca_tbl)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-sca-timeseries
#| fig-cap: "SCA time series of depletion (SSB/SSB0) and relative fishing mortality (F/FMSY)."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

years <- styr:endyr
len_ts <- min(length(res@SSB_SSB0), length(years))

sca_ts <- data.frame(
  Year = years[1:len_ts],
  Depletion = res@SSB_SSB0[1:len_ts],
  Rel_F = res@F_FMSY[1:len_ts]
)

sca_long <- reshape(
  sca_ts,
  varying = c("Depletion", "Rel_F"),
  v.names = "Value",
  timevar = "Metric",
  times = c("SSB/SSB0", "F/FMSY"),
  direction = "long"
)

ggplot(sca_long, aes(Year, Value)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "SCA time series", x = "Year", y = NULL) +
  theme_report
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-sca-selectivity
#| fig-cap: "Terminal-year selectivity-at-age from the SCA assessment."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

sel_last <- res@Selectivity[nrow(res@Selectivity), -1]
sel_df <- data.frame(Age = ages, Selectivity = sel_last)

ggplot(sel_df, aes(Age, Selectivity)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "steelblue") +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(title = "Selectivity-at-age (terminal year)", x = "Age", y = "Selectivity") +
  theme_report
```

### SCA report

The SAMtool report is optional here because it triggers a nested render. Toggle
`eval: true` in the chunk below if you want Quarto to generate it during a run.
The full diagnostic report complements the summary outputs in
@tbl-sca-summary and @fig-sca-timeseries and @fig-sca-selectivity; the
expected file location is recorded in @tbl-sca-report-path.

```{r}
#| label: sca-report
#| eval: false

dir.create(report_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
report_file <- SAMtool:::report(res, dir = report_dir, open_file = FALSE)
report_file
```

Expected report path:

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sca-report-path
#| tbl-cap: "Expected SCA report output path."

gt_caption(
  data.frame(Report = normalizePath(file.path(report_dir, "report_SCA.html"), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
)
```

## Condition the operating model (Assess2OM)

SCA-derived quantities are transformed into age-structured arrays to condition
the operating model. The resulting OM dimensions are reported in
@tbl-om-summary, and the conditioning preserves historical dynamics summarized
in @fig-sca-timeseries while carrying forward growth and maturity
patterns from @fig-length-at-age and @fig-maturity-curve.

```{r}
#| label: assess2om

# Extract arrays from SCA result (drop age-0 column)
N_mat <- res@N_at_age[, -1]

# F-at-age
F_at_age_mat <- (as.numeric(res@FMort) * res@Selectivity)[, -1]

# Weight-at-age: use fishery data for all years
wt_age_mat <- wt_fsh

# Maturity-at-age: replicate across years
mat_mat <- matrix(p_mature, nrow = nyears, ncol = nages, byrow = TRUE)

# Natural mortality: age-specific vector
M_vec <- c(0.9, 0.45, rep(0.3, nages - 2))
M_mat <- matrix(M_vec, nrow = nyears, ncol = nages, byrow = TRUE)

# Length-at-age: replicate across years
laa_mat <- matrix(len_at_age, nrow = nyears, ncol = nages, byrow = TRUE)

# Helper: convert [nyears, nages] matrix -> [nsim, nages, nyears] array
mat2arr <- function(m, nsim = nsim_om) {
  arr1 <- array(t(m), dim = c(1, ncol(m), nrow(m)))
  arr1[rep(1, nsim), , , drop = FALSE]
}

naa_array <- mat2arr(N_mat[1:nyears, ])
faa_array <- mat2arr(F_at_age_mat)
waa_array <- mat2arr(wt_age_mat)
Mataa_array <- mat2arr(mat_mat)
Maa_array <- mat2arr(M_mat)
laa_array <- mat2arr(laa_mat)

h_val <- if (length(res@h) > 0 && res@h > 0) res@h else steep

OM <- Assess2OM(
  Name = "EBS Pollock",
  naa = naa_array,
  faa = faa_array,
  waa = waa_array,
  Mataa = Mataa_array,
  Maa = Maa_array,
  laa = laa_array,
  CurrentYr = endyr,
  h = h_val,
  proyears = proyears,
  recind = recage,
  plusgroup = TRUE,
  report = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-om-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Operating model dimensions."

om_tbl <- data.frame(
  Field = c("nsim", "nyears", "maxage", "proyears"),
  Value = c(OM@nsim, OM@nyears, OM@maxage, OM@proyears)
)

gt_caption(om_tbl)
```

## Run a basic MSE demonstration

The MSE explores candidate MPs under the conditioned OM to quantify trade-offs
among yield and risk metrics. Performance metrics are summarized in
@tbl-mse-summary and visualized across MPs in @fig-mse-metrics-plot as a
precursor to the detailed MP diagnostics in the next section.

```{r}
#| label: run-mse

MSE_result <- runMSE(OM, MPs = c("curEref","FMSYref", "FMSYref75", "NFref"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mse-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Performance metrics for example MPs."

perf <- tryCatch(MSE_result@PM, error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(perf)) {
  perf_tbl <- as.data.frame(perf)
  perf_tbl$MP <- rownames(perf)
  perf_tbl <- perf_tbl[, c("MP", setdiff(names(perf_tbl), "MP"))]
  gt_caption(perf_tbl)
} else {
  summary_tbl <- tryCatch(summary(MSE_result, silent = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.data.frame(summary_tbl)) {
    if (!("MP" %in% names(summary_tbl))) {
      summary_tbl$MP <- rownames(summary_tbl)
    }
    summary_tbl <- summary_tbl[, c("MP", setdiff(names(summary_tbl), "MP")), drop = FALSE]
    gt_caption(summary_tbl)
  } else {
    summary(MSE_result)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mse-metrics-plot
#| fig-cap: "Performance metrics by management procedure."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

if (!is.null(perf)) {
  perf_tbl <- as.data.frame(perf)
  perf_tbl$MP <- rownames(perf_tbl)
  metric_cols <- setdiff(names(perf_tbl), "MP")

  perf_long <- reshape(
    perf_tbl,
    varying = metric_cols,
    v.names = "Value",
    timevar = "Metric",
    times = metric_cols,
    direction = "long"
  )

  ggplot(perf_long, aes(MP, Value, fill = Metric)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(title = "Performance metrics", x = "Management procedure", y = "Value") +
    theme_report
}
```

## Management procedure results

This section presents standard MP diagnostics and aggregated performance
summaries. Projection trajectories and end-of-horizon status are shown in
@fig-mse-pplot and @fig-mse-kplot, trade-off surfaces in
@fig-mse-tplot, and the quilt-style summary across metrics in
@tbl-mse-quilt.

### Standard MSE plots

The standard MSE panels depict simulated trajectories of F/FMSY and B/BMSY by
MP (@fig-mse-pplot) and summarize end-state status in the Kobe-style
plot (@fig-mse-kplot). The multi-metric trade-off visualization in
@fig-mse-tplot complements these dynamics by highlighting performance
across multiple objectives. These trajectory diagnostics are complemented by
the quilt summary in @tbl-mse-quilt.

```{r}
#| label: fig-mse-pplot
#| fig-cap: "Standard projection plots (F/FMSY and B/BMSY) by management procedure."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7

Pplot(MSE_result)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mse-kplot
#| fig-cap: "Kobe-style status plot at the end of the projection period."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

Kplot(MSE_result)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mse-tplot
#| fig-cap: "Trade-off plots for common performance metrics."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  Tplot(MSE_result)
} else {
  cat("Package 'ggrepel' is required for trade-off plots (Tplot).")
}
```

### Quilt tables

The quilt table aggregates mean performance across simulations for each MP and
metric, providing a compact complement to the trajectory plots. See
@tbl-mse-quilt for the summary and @fig-mse-pplot through
@fig-mse-tplot for temporal context.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mse-quilt
#| tbl-cap: "Quilt table of mean performance metrics across MPs."

if (requireNamespace("Slick", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {
  perf <- tryCatch(MSE_result@PM, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(perf)) {
    perf_tbl <- tryCatch(summary(MSE_result, silent = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else {
    perf_tbl <- as.data.frame(perf)
  }

  if (!is.null(perf_tbl)) {
    # Prefer standard performance metrics when available.
    metric_order <- c("PNOF", "P50", "P10", "P100", "LTY", "STY", "AAVY")
    metrics <- intersect(metric_order, setdiff(colnames(perf_tbl), "MP"))
    if (length(metrics) == 0) {
      metrics <- setdiff(colnames(perf_tbl), "MP")
    }
    if (length(metrics) > 0) {
      metric_is_num <- vapply(perf_tbl[, metrics, drop = FALSE], is.numeric, logical(1))
      metrics <- metrics[metric_is_num]
    }
    if (length(metrics) == 0) {
      cat("No numeric performance metrics available for quilt tables.")
    } else {

      if (!("MP" %in% names(perf_tbl))) {
        mp_names <- rownames(perf_tbl)
        if (is.null(mp_names) || all(mp_names == "")) {
          mp_names <- MSE_result@MPs[seq_len(nrow(perf_tbl))]
        }
        perf_tbl$MP <- mp_names
      }
      perf_tbl <- perf_tbl[, c("MP", metrics), drop = FALSE]

      n_mp <- nrow(perf_tbl)
      n_pi <- length(metrics)
      values <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(1, n_mp, n_pi))
      values[1, , ] <- as.matrix(perf_tbl[, metrics, drop = FALSE])

      quilt <- Slick::Quilt(
        Code = metrics,
        Label = metrics,
        Description = metrics,
        Value = values
      )

      slick <- Slick::Slick()
      mps <- Slick::MPs(
        Code = perf_tbl$MP,
        Label = perf_tbl$MP,
        Description = rep("", n_mp),
        Color = Slick::default_mp_colors(n_mp)
      )
      Slick::MPs(slick) <- mps
      Slick::Quilt(slick) <- quilt

      Slick::plotQuilt(slick)
    }
  } else {
    cat("No performance metrics available to build quilt tables.")
  }
} else {
  cat("Packages 'Slick' and 'DT' are required for quilt tables; skipping.")
}
```

## Slick object export

The MSE results can be assembled into a `Slick` object for downstream
visualization and sharing. The object preserves the MP trajectories shown in
@fig-mse-pplot through @fig-mse-tplot and can embed the quilt summary
from @tbl-mse-quilt when performance metrics are available.

```{r}
#| label: build-slick

if (requireNamespace("Slick", quietly = TRUE)) {
  source(file.path(doc_dir, "R", "mse2slick.R"))

  slick_obj <- MSE2Slick(
    MSE_result,
    title = "EBS Pollock MSE",
    subtitle = "SCA-conditioned operating model",
    author = "openMSE"
  )

  perf_tbl <- NULL
  if (exists("perf_tbl")) {
    perf_tbl <- perf_tbl
  } else {
    perf <- tryCatch(MSE_result@PM, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(perf)) {
      perf_tbl <- as.data.frame(perf)
      perf_tbl$MP <- rownames(perf_tbl)
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(perf_tbl)) {
    metric_order <- c("PNOF", "P50", "P10", "P100", "LTY", "STY", "AAVY")
    metrics <- intersect(metric_order, setdiff(colnames(perf_tbl), "MP"))
    if (length(metrics) > 0) {
      values <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(1, nrow(perf_tbl), length(metrics)))
      values[1, , ] <- as.matrix(perf_tbl[, metrics, drop = FALSE])

      quilt <- Slick::Quilt(
        Code = metrics,
        Label = metrics,
        Description = metrics,
        Value = values
      )
      Slick::Quilt(slick_obj) <- quilt
    }
  }

  Slick::Check(slick_obj)
  saveRDS(slick_obj, file.path(report_dir, "pollock_slick.rds"))
} else {
  cat("Package 'Slick' is not installed; skipping Slick object export.")
}
```

## Outputs

Key artifacts include the optional SCA report path documented in
@tbl-sca-report-path and the MP performance diagnostics summarized in
@fig-mse-pplot through @fig-mse-tplot and @tbl-mse-quilt. The objects
listed below can be saved for reproducibility and downstream analysis.

- The SCA diagnostic report (if rendered) is written to `r normalizePath(file.path(report_dir, "report_SCA.html"), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)`.
- The `OM` and `MSE_result` objects are in memory and can be saved with `saveRDS()` if needed.
